context_for_next_testing_agent: POM Library and Code Configuration features fully implemented and tested. POM Library stores measurement point definitions (code, name, category, unit) and integrates with Measurement Chart Panel. Code Configuration allows configuring prefix, separator, date format, and sequence digits for each entity type (asset, product, material, color). The generate endpoint returns next available code and increments sequence. BOM and Measurement panels have AG Grid-like styling with inline editing and keyboard navigation support.
